title: Integrate reviewed Commons slice and reconcile project memory
statement: Commons PR #8 reports a working local find-inspect-draft-submit-rediscover flow and 149 passing tests at e24838f. Final batch-4 repairs still lack independent review. Published knowledge at main 58b9942 was complete but carried invalid_status and invalid_relation errors for the timetable. This branch integrates main and repairs both schema values; a real producer build yields 25 records, 15/15 sources and zero diagnostics. Knowledge Lab #1 has been retargeted from its merged dependency branch to main; GitHub subsequently reports it mergeable against main; combined tests still need revalidation.
conditions: The context packet is dated at 93a5445; current deployed knowledge was independently read at 58b9942.
Commons tests and browser results are coordinator/reviewer reports, not rerun during this progress review.
No NUC service state was inspected; previous runtime results do not establish current deployment.
No product or architecture decisions are accepted by this proposal.

next_steps: ["Review Commons e24838f final delta; run app gates and two-session demo, then merge #8 if accepted. Keep local-only.", "Reconcile Knowledge Lab #1 with main and rerun tests; review Observstory #20 before integrating its host consumer.", "Merge memory write-back #4 after CI and content review. Preserve all proposals as unreviewed and proposed architecture as proposed.", "PDF #6 is an independent optional narrative change; review visually before merging.", "Refresh published snapshot after integration and verify knowledge diagnostics are empty.", "Add app CI so green Observatory workflow cannot be mistaken for application verification."]

open_decisions: ["Prioritize Commons demo and usability now versus further memory infrastructure (recommend Commons).", "Keep demo local through Sunday noon; public deployment needs a separate auth/hosting implementation.", "Select one real question and near-match for human acceptance; retain PDF as optional framing.", "Enable persistent NUC memory only after reconciled integration; paid indexing remains separately bounded and unauthorized."]
